context: Evaluates correct use of spprof's Profile.aggregate() method and the AggregatedProfile data model. The candidate must call aggregate(), read AggregatedProfile properties (unique_stack_count, compression_ratio, memory_reduction_pct, total_samples), and traverse AggregatedStack items.

checklist.name: aggregate() call
checklist.description: Calls profile.aggregate() on the Profile object to obtain an AggregatedProfile instance.

checklist.name: AggregatedProfile properties
checklist.description: Reads and prints agg.unique_stack_count, agg.compression_ratio, agg.memory_reduction_pct, and agg.total_samples.

checklist.name: AggregatedStack traversal
checklist.description: Iterates over agg.stacks and accesses .frames, .count, .thread_id on at least one AggregatedStack.

checklist.name: compression_ratio >= 1.0
checklist.description: Verifies that agg.compression_ratio is >= 1.0, indicating aggregation did not inflate the data.
